full_name: Glenda Gilmore | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
bio: An assistant professor of history at Yale University, Glenda Gilmore focuses her research on the American South. Gilmore’s research ranges from progressivism to the Jim Crow laws and the politics of race and gender in the American South.
